system.description: You tie silk ribbons around the ankles of up to six creatures.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and they may stop moving without sinking or falling.
outcomes.success: For 1 hour, they can walk across liquid, thin ice or vertical surfaces, provided they do not stop moving.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and materials are lost.
outcomes.ruin: The ribbons work too well on you: you have Bane on Agility tests for 1 hour as the ground slides beneath you. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
